description: Aggregate counts of U.S. fatal police shootings since 2015, from The Washington Post Fatal Force database. Group by state, year, race, armed_with, threat_type, gender, mental_illness, or body_camera; optionally scope to one state and/or one year first. Returns only counts — never names (use police_shootings for individual incidents). CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, attributed to The Washington Post.

group_by.description: How to bucket the counts. Default "year".

state.description: Two-letter USPS state code to scope to (e.g. "CA"). Optional.

year.description: Calendar year to scope to (2015-present). Optional.

name: police_shootings_summary
title: Police Shootings Summary
